description: Source code for handling OpenAPI V3 discovery and group version serving in Kubernetes, including caching, URL construction, and HTTP handlers.

classes.name: openAPIV3Group
classes.description: Represents a cached group of OpenAPI v3 specifications with JSON and protobuf caches.

classes.name: OpenAPIService
classes.description: Service responsible for serving OpenAPI specifications and discovery documents with thread-safe updates and HTTP handlers.

methods.name: ToV3ProtoBinary
methods.description: Converts JSON bytes of an OpenAPI document to protobuf binary format.

methods.name: newOpenAPIV3Group
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new openAPIV3Group with caches.

methods.name: UpdateSpec
methods.description: Updates the spec cache for an openAPIV3Group.

methods.name: NewOpenAPIService
methods.description: Constructs a new OpenAPIService with initial discovery cache.

methods.name: buildDiscoveryCacheLocked
methods.description: Builds the cached discovery document with current group schemas.

methods.name: getSingleGroupBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the bytes, ETag, and last modified time for a specific group and content type.

methods.name: UpdateGroupVersionLazy
methods.description: Adds or updates a group with a cached OpenAPI spec, rebuilding discovery cache.

methods.name: UpdateGroupVersion
methods.description: Adds or updates a group with a new OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: DeleteGroupVersion
methods.description: Removes a group and updates the discovery cache.

methods.name: HandleDiscovery
methods.description: HTTP handler for serving the OpenAPI discovery document.

methods.name: HandleGroupVersion
methods.description: HTTP handler for serving specific group version in JSON or protobuf format, with cache validation.

methods.name: RegisterOpenAPIV3VersionedService
methods.description: Registers HTTP handlers for OpenAPI V3 discovery and group version endpoints.
